title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go + parity + version bumps
author: Maya Rodriguez
description: This PR consolidates several ergonomics and parity mismatches across the three official SDKs (python, typescript, go). Motivation: teams observed inconsistent behavior between SDKs for auth token refresh, retry backoff defaults, and streaming response handling; this caused debugging churn in multi-language integrations. Changes include: 1) unified auth layer with automatic short-lived token refresh and pluggable credential provider interface; 2) consistent retry policy defaults (exponential backoff with jitter, 4 retries for idempotent calls, 2 for non-idempotent by default) and a common RetryConfig surface across SDKs; 3) streaming API parity: unified event framing and simple async iterator ergonomics (Python async generator, TS async iterable, Go channel helper); 4) small ergonomics improvements: default JSON parsing helpers for structured outputs, clearer error classes, and better typed definitions in TS; 5) version bumps: python -> 1.12.0, typescript -> 1.12.0, go -> v1.12.0 module tags; 6) docs/examples and changelogs updated. Compatibility: all changes are backwards-compatible defaults (opt-in strict mode available via clients.Config.strict_compat). Tests: added cross-sdk integration tests that run against the local mock server; CI matrix verifies feature parity. Rolling plan: merged to main, will cut SDK releases CI job after release notes validation. See linked Linear tasks for rollout tickets.

release_notes:
- Unified auth provider with automatic token refresh across SDKs.
- Standardized retry defaults and RetryConfig surface.
- Streaming API ergonomics and framing parity (async iterators / channels).
- Small ergonomics improvements and typed TS definitions.
- Bumped SDK versions to 1.12.0 (python, typescript, go).
notes_for_rollout: After merge: trigger sdk-release workflow to publish packages to PyPI, npm, and Go module proxy. Notify integrations team and post migration guide link in #sdk-updates. Monitor error rates and auth-related latencies for 48h.
changelog: See per-SDK CHANGELOGs updated in their respective folders. Key user-facing changes: token refresh handled automatically, retry behavior standardized, streaming helpers added for easier consumption.
test_coverage: integration: high (added end-to-end multi-sdk streaming test), unit: expanded auth/retry unit tests for edge cases
user_impact: low to medium - defaults are backwards-compatible. Users opting into strict_compat may need to adjust custom retry hooks.
manual_steps: Run ci/release/sdks_version_bump.yml after tagging. For enterprise customers using pinned SDKs, coordinate upgrade window and share migration guide.
security_notes: Auth changes rely on short-lived tokens and refresh; no new secrets stored on disk. KMS/HSM integrations unaffected. Reviewed by security (Priya Singh).
